history.summary: An own-stay/school-zone-marketed 4BR in Clementi (D05) priced at $2.58M / $2032 PSF, but the listing hides the actual project name behind a Nan Hua school hook and carries no URA appreciation, transaction or median-PSF data. As an investment with the project identity and price history unverifiable, this is a thin, school-buyer-niche entry rather than a yield/exit-driven buy.
history.rating_rationale: $2032 PSF for a 99yr 4BR in D05 is mid-market, not a bargain, and the 840m walk to Clementi MRT is mediocre. Score 471/1000 and Elo 1325 are below-market. The Nan Hua school-zone angle drives own-stay demand, not investment appreciation, and the 4BR/$2.58M band has a shallower resale pool than 2-3BR. No URA data to confirm the rate or that PSF is fair.
red_flags: Project name masked behind school-zone marketing — identity/price-history unverifiable
4BR at $2.58M is a niche, school-buyer-dependent exit
catalysts: 1km to Nan Hua Primary (P1 priority demand from families)
D05 One-North/Science Park employment base supports tenant demand
